title: Photo Inspection, Due Date and Removal of Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Rule.**
- Every coverage added under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) needs a photo inspection made up of the package's photo set. It is waived for a new vehicle with a dealer bill of sale dated within 7 days of the coverage effective date.
- An inspection is approved no later than the inspection due date of the coverage.
- The inspection due date is the coverage effective date plus the package's inspection due days, counted in calendar days, with the effective date as day 0. Approval on the due date itself qualifies.
- When no approved inspection is received by the due date, the coverage is removed effective 12:01 a.m. on the day after the due date, and its premium from that date is returned.
- A loss before the inspection was approved is covered for the damage from that loss, but no payment is issued until the inspection photos are received.
- The named insured may also ask to remove the coverage at any time, effective no earlier than the request.

### The time test, stated exactly

| Element | Setting |
|---|---|
| Clock | Today's date |
| Anchor | The inspection due date shown on the coverage record |
| How the due date is set | Coverage effective date plus the package's inspection due days, effective date as day 0 |
| Lag allowed after the due date | 0 calendar days |
| Direction | Approval not later than the due date plus that lag |
| Boundary | Inclusive: approval on the due date itself qualifies |

Hypothetical boundary cases, for a package with 7 inspection due days and an effective date of the 3rd of a month:
- The due date is the 10th.
- Approval on the 10th is on time.
- Approval on the 11th is too late. With no approved inspection by the 10th, the removal takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on the 11th, and premium from the 11th is returned.

### Loss payee notice

The former clause on loss payee notice before removal is **no longer in force**: it has been superseded by the current basis. That clause read: a coverage with a loss payee is removed no earlier than the loss payee notice days, in calendar days, after the loss payee was notified.

superseded_clauses: A coverage with a loss payee is removed no earlier than loss_payee_notice_days calendar days after the loss payee was notified.
